mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome to a journey that goes far beyond what we see and touch—one that invites us right into the heart of longing, mystery, and the search for something greater. Have you ever felt a pull toward the unknown, a sense that love itself might be the answer to questions you can’t quite put into words? That’s the invitation waiting for us inside The Essential Rumi, a collection that brings to life the soul-stirring poetry of Jalal ad-Din Muhammad ar-Rumi. Together, we’ll wander through verses where love isn’t just a feeling—it’s a journey, a question, and ultimately, the answer itself. Rumi’s words sweep us into a world where the longing of the heart becomes the very path to awakening, and where the boundaries between self and the divine start to blur. As we explore these poems, you’ll notice how each one opens a new door—inviting us to feel grief, joy, confusion, and awe, all woven together by the thread of something deeper: divine love. The Essential Rumi offers timeless glimpses into the mysteries of existence and the ecstasy of surrender, guiding us through stories of seekers, lovers, and spiritual teachers—all reaching for meaning within the embrace of the infinite. Through Rumi’s shimmering metaphors and rhythms, we’re reminded of our own hidden longing, and we’re invited to remember the unity that lies beneath all our differences. So, as we step into these verses together, let’s stay open to the beauty, the paradox, and the transformative power of love that waits on every page. Are you ready to discover what your heart has been longing for?
